messages:
carol: CI red on PR #3421 — unit tests failed (12/14 nodes). Can I rerun only the failing job(s) without rebuilding docker images? Want to avoid the 15m image build.

ben: yep, use our dev-ci tool to requeue just the job and skip image build. Example:
```
dev-ci requeue --pr 3421 --jobs unit_tests --no-build
```
That preserves artifacts from previous image build.

sam: +1, also you can target a matrix axis by suffix: `--jobs unit_tests:py38` if you need a specific shard.

carol: great — are there any gotchas? do flaky tests still get rerun across same workers?

ci-bot: I can run that for you if you tag me: `@ci-bot requeue pr=3421 jobs=unit_tests no_build=true`
Started requeue job 2093459999 — running unit_tests on existing artifact set.

maya: if it still flakes, consider bisecting on the suspect commit range:
```
dev-ci bisect --pr 3421 --tests unit_tests --start 9f1a2 --end d3c4b
```
It will run a bisection across commits using the cached environments.

carol: thanks all — triggering `@ci-bot` now. Will report back if green :crossed_fingers:

ben: tip: for quick local sanity you can run the failing test file with `tox -e py38 -- tests/test_thing.py::TestFoo` to reproduce faster before rerun.

ci-bot: requeue complete — workflow 2093460001 queued. ETA ~8m for job finish :hourglass_flowing_sand:

carol: got green, merging. thanks :rocket:
